faqs.q: What are the Bijur Delimon Denco Constant Level Oilers and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon Denco Constant Level Oilers hold the oil level in a bearing housing or gearbox and top it up automatically from a clear back-up reservoir. As the oil level falls it uncovers the feed tube, air enters the reservoir and an equal amount of oil runs down to restore the set level. See the [single-point lubricators and oilers](/c/single-point-lubricators) shelf for related equipment.

faqs.q: Which part numbers does the Bijur Delimon Denco Constant Level Oilers range include?
faqs.a: The range lists 14 part numbers in series N, Q (1/4 BSP), R, L, P (1/4 API) and E (1 BSP), with reservoirs from 100 to 250 ml. Glass reservoirs, wire cages and mounting unions are listed.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Bijur Delimon Denco Constant Level Oilers?
faqs.a: A single-point lubricator serves one bearing, chain or slide without wiring. For a constant level oiler choose the series by the thread on the housing, 1/4BSP, 1/4API or 1BSP, then the reservoir size.

faqs.q: What are the ratings and output of the Bijur Delimon Denco Constant Level Oilers?
faqs.a: The operating range is -10°C-60°C, and containers of 100-500ml fit the series. The listed reservoirs are 100ml and 250ml.

faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon Denco Constant Level Oilers keep a set oil level in the housing, while the LubeSite drip and gravity-feed oilers meter a flow of oil to a point.
